sources.author: Clark Kimberling
sources.use: The question asks which real slopes yield a homogeneous linearly recurrent subsequence in floor(n*r). The quadratic/r>1 hypotheses here belong to this construction.

sources.author: Brian Conrad
sources.title: Math 154. Generalized Pell equation
sources.use: Positive norm-one units exist for every positive nonsquare integer D; a fundamental unit is not required. Example 3.1 explicitly records the unit 4+sqrt(15). Its generalized-Pell search and example were not replayed.

sources.author: Robert Silber
sources.title: A Fibonacci Property of Wythoff Pairs
sources.use: Prior recurrence constructions for the golden-ratio Beatty/Wythoff setting. No exact match to the entire present parameterized family or novelty claim is asserted.
